connector.name: AlbumentationsX MCP

connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package albumentationsx-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

env.name: ALBU_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS

env.name: ALBU_MCP_ARTIFACT_ROOT
env.description: Optional local directory where generated preview artifacts and manifests are written.

env.name: ALBU_MCP_MAX_PREVIEW_RUNS
env.description: Optional retention limit for indexed preview runs. Defaults to 100.
